title: Basic Relay Control
learning_objective: Pushbutton energizes the coil (24VDC). Relay NO contact switches the lamp on.
story_text: Wire a pushbutton to turn on the lamp through the relay's NO contact.

common_mistakes.explanation: The lamp is on NC, so it is lit when the relay is OFF.

hints: NO means Normally Open — closed only when the coil is powered.
